Madras High Court Questions Tamil Nadu Govt on RSS March Ban

The Madras High Court questioned the Tamil Nadu government, led by Chief Minister Thalapathy Vijay, regarding its decision to deny permission for an RSS march. The court specifically asked why permission was granted for a similar march in Jammu and Kashmir but denied in Tamil Nadu. The court's queries were directed at the police, indicating a strong reaction to the government's stance.
